AsocInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the Agentic SOC Credits instance. If SiemOrderFrom is CREDITS_PRE_PAY, the ID of the subscription Credits instance is returned. If SiemOrderFrom is CREDITS_POST_PAY, the ID of the pay-as-you-go Credits instance is returned. This field is empty if no Credits instance is found. The ID of the Security Center instance for legacy orders is returned by SasInstanceId
AsocInstanceId.description_zh: Agentic SOC Credits 实例 ID。SiemOrderFrom 为 CREDITS_PRE_PAY 时，返回 Credits 预付费订阅实例 ID；为 CREDITS_POST_PAY 时，返回 Credits 后付费实例 ID。未查询到 Credits 实例时为空。老售卖订单的云安全中心实例 ID 由 SasInstanceId 返回

AsocSubscriptionInstanceEndTime.description_en: The end time of the Agentic SOC Credits subscription. The value is a 13-digit UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. This field is returned only when SiemOrderFrom is CREDITS_PRE_PAY. Otherwise, this field is empty
AsocSubscriptionInstanceEndTime.description_zh: Agentic SOC Credits 预付费订阅的结束时间，单位为毫秒的 Unix 时间戳，共 13 位。仅 SiemOrderFrom 为 CREDITS_PRE_PAY 时返回，其他场景为空

AsocSubscriptionInstanceStartTime.description_en: The start time of the Agentic SOC Credits subscription. The value is a 13-digit UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. This field is returned only when SiemOrderFrom is CREDITS_PRE_PAY. Otherwise, this field is empty
AsocSubscriptionInstanceStartTime.description_zh: Agentic SOC Credits 预付费订阅的开始时间，单位为毫秒的 Unix 时间戳，共 13 位。仅 SiemOrderFrom 为 CREDITS_PRE_PAY 时返回，其他场景为空

false: The account cannot manage Threat Analysis orders

CapacityOrderFrom.description_en:
The source of the log storage capacity order. Valid values:
PRE_PAY_CAPACITY: The subscription capacity order.
POST_PAY_CAPACITY: The pay-as-you-go capacity order.
The source of the capacity order is independent of the source of the traffic order represented by SiemOrderFrom
CapacityOrderFrom.description_zh:
日志存储容量订单来源。取值：
PRE_PAY_CAPACITY：预付费容量订单。
POST_PAY_CAPACITY：后付费容量订单。

容量订单来源独立于 SiemOrderFrom 所表示的流量订单来源

SiemOrderFrom.description_en:
The source of the traffic order. Valid values:
PRE_PAY_FLOW: The subscription traffic order for Threat Analysis.
POST_PAY_FLOW: The pay-as-you-go traffic order for Threat Analysis.
CREDITS_PRE_PAY: The subscription of Agentic SOC Credits.
CREDITS_POST_PAY: The pay-as-you-go instance of Agentic SOC Credits.
This field describes the source of the traffic order. The source of the log storage capacity order is independently represented by CapacityOrderFrom
SiemOrderFrom.description_zh:
流量订单来源。取值：
PRE_PAY_FLOW：威胁分析预付费流量订单。
POST_PAY_FLOW：威胁分析后付费流量订单。
CREDITS_PRE_PAY：Agentic SOC Credits 预付费订阅。
CREDITS_POST_PAY：Agentic SOC Credits 后付费实例。

此字段描述流量订单来源；日志存储容量订单来源由 CapacityOrderFrom 独立表示
